sense: a side of a room or building

pins.definition: A vertical structure that defines, encloses, or separates a room or a building.
A vertical side of a room or building.
A vertical structure that encloses or divides a room or building.

situation: A painter stands on a wooden ladder indoors, applying a solid expanse of colour across the side of a room.
subject: the vertical room side
brief: A tall, flat plastered interior partition fills the frame, stretching from dark wooden floorboards up to a high white ceiling. A person on a low wooden stepladder reaches up with a long-handled roller, coating the middle of the vertical surface in a broad band of fresh paint.
prompt: A tall, flat plastered interior partition fills the frame, stretching from dark wooden floorboards up to a high white ceiling. A person on a low wooden stepladder reaches up with a long-handled roller, coating the middle of the vertical surface in a broad band of fresh paint. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
